forecaster-truenote.about: positive control: one correct finding naming all three mechanisms and the decoy

notes.author: analyst
notes.text: y has three nonlinear sources; none is visible in a linear screen. (1) Interaction: y rises with the product x03*x09 (coef ~0.25); corr(x03,y) and corr(x09,y) are ~0. x13 is x03*x09 plus noise: it correlates with y (+0.19) only through the product and drops out once x03*x09 is in the model. (2) Oscillation: y follows sin(2.5*x06) (coef ~0.35); corr(x06,y) is ~0.03 because the effect rises, falls and rises again. (3) Threshold: y rises with x11 only above 0.5, as 0.55*max(x11-0.5, 0); below 0.5 x11 has no effect.
